article.title: Transforming Donors: The Revolution Could Be Funded
article.author: Isaac Lev Szmonko
article.content: When funders are retrenching and we’re worried about making our budget, it can be hard to dream wildly about how to sustain not just our own organizations, but a vibrant Left ecosystem that has enough funding and scaled infrastructure to steadily march us past both authoritarianism and the racist neoliberalism that got us here. But we are living in the culmination of 60 years of right-wing funding… Source
